title: I Love a Mystery
paragraphs: Carlton E. Morse’s serialized mystery-adventure series follows Jack Packard, Doc Long, and their companions through long-form cases filled with danger, crime, and the uncanny.
Carlton E. Morse serialized mystery-adventure about Jack Packard, Doc Long, Reggie Yorke and later Jerry Booker.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: NBC West Coast daily serial (January 16, 1939 to September 29, 1939) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], National NBC daily serial (October 2, 1939 to March 29, 1940) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], NBC/Blue weekly half-hour era (April 4, 1940 to June 29, 1942) on [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]], and CBS weekday serial (March 22, 1943 to December 29, 1944) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Jim Boles (performer), Russell Thorson (performer), Carleton E. Morse (writer, creator, and producer), Frank McCarthy (announcer), Tony Randall (performer), Mercedes McCambridge (performer), and Barton Yarborough (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]], [[org|org.41e846edb6a1b781|KALW-FM]], [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

The stories often return to international travel and remote settings, murder and violent crime, vampires, supernatural and uncanny threats, detective work and investigation, and war and military conflict.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Network mystery-adventure serial culture, Postwar revival through script reuse, Reggie Yorke removed after Walter Paterson death, and I Love Adventure continuation.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|the-mysterious-traveler|The Mysterious Traveler]], [[show|cbs-radio-workshop|CBS Radio Workshop]], [[show|let-george-do-it|Let George Do It]], and [[show|x-minus-one|X Minus One]].
